_comment: Frozen legacy baseline for the audit-ledger PATH-citation invariant. A ledger that names an in-repo artifact is ASSERTING that artifact exists. #156 shipped a closing report claiming to carry a prepared issue body it did not contain, and the same class had already been raised twice inside that slice as a measured-but-never-pinned claim - the second instance is this repository's trigger for replacing the enumeration with an invariant, which is the test that reads this file. Resolution is by PATH SUFFIX against the git index, because every ledger writes package-relative shorthand; and paths under a gitignored root are excluded first, because they exist on disk and simply are not tracked. What remains here are citations that do not resolve today and are not this slice's to repair: one evidence file an earlier slice named but never wrote, two more of the same in another, and one module path that no longer exists under any prefix. Editing another slice's committed ledger row is what this repository forbids, so they are recorded rather than rewritten. The set is FROZEN and asserted exactly - it cannot grow, so a NEW unresolvable citation in ANY ledger, including these, fails. Generated by measurement, never hand-edited.
